_comment: v1 multi-project example. Rename to appsettings.json (or merge into it) to enable multi-project mode. While this file is included by name the orchestrator ignores it; once activated, the legacy workspace.root is ignored and the projects[] array becomes the source of truth.

projects.name: Suikoden Launcher
projects._deploymentComment: Example DeploymentKind.Script: no build/publish/service bounce, just a one-line release action. ScriptPath is resolved relative to root when not absolute. The script receives FORGE_DEPLOY_PROJECT_ID / FORGE_DEPLOY_COMMIT_SHA / FORGE_DEPLOY_PROJECT_ROOT in its environment.

projects.name: Forge
projects._deploymentComment: Example DeploymentKind.SelfHostedWindowsService: Forge redeploying itself. This is the ONLY deployment kind that needs the Forge.Deployer hand-off, because the thing being deployed IS the process approving the deployment. See docs/deployment-pipeline.md.
